verdict.rationale: Square's Terminal API documents collecting tips on the Terminal, with a separate tip input screen and custom tip amounts. Community reports corroborate preset tip options ($2/$5) plus an 'other tip' choice on Square hardware, and tip prompts at checkout. Configuring percentage-based presets and smart amounts is not documented. missing for 10: documented configuration of tip percentages, smart tip amounts, merchant-side settings for preset values, explicit reader (vs. Terminal) coverage

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal

citations.quote: Tip money: Collect tips as money at checkout. Supports showing a separate tip input screen before getting a buyer's signature and allowing custom tip amounts.
Use the Terminal API to connect a custom POS application with a Square Terminal.
the person could see them tap 'other tip' to give $1 instead of the $2 or $5 options
